lines.zh: 我小跑着，尾巴一甩一甩。
lines.en: I trot along, tail swishing.

lines.zh: 下界的砖烫脚，我跳着走。
lines.en: Nether brick is hot. I hop.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，躲着岩浆。
lines.en: I hug the wall, avoiding lava.
Short legs, quick pace.
I drag a spellbook along.

lines.zh: 我绕过一堆萤石，往深处。
lines.en: I skirt a glowstone pile and go deeper.

lines.zh: 蹄子踏在石头上，哒哒响。
lines.en: My hooves click on the stone.

lines.zh: 我在熔岩海边走，很小心。
lines.en: I walk the lava shore, careful.

lines.zh: 我背着东西，走得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: Loaded down, I waddle.

lines.zh: 这条矿道我走过很多回。
lines.en: I have walked this tunnel often.
One hop carries me two blocks.

lines.zh: 下界的热风把我的耳朵吹翻。
lines.en: The hot wind flips my ears.
I sit with my tail curled at my feet.

lines.zh: 我用爪子翻那本魔法书。
lines.en: I flip the spellbook with a claw.

lines.zh: 下界没有夜，我也不会困。
lines.en: No night here, and I do not sleep.
Fire crackles far off. I listen.

lines.zh: 这本书记的东西，我认得一半。
lines.en: I know half of what this book says.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫净脚边的灰。
lines.en: I sweep the ash from my feet with my tail.
I count glowstone specks.
My claws are dull. Time to sharpen.

lines.zh: 锁链锁着我这个形态，挺好。
lines.en: The chain holds my form. Fine by me.
I wait for someone to buy.
Buying a spellbook? I have some.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，主世界来的。
lines.en: You smell of the Overworld.
Got nether coin?
You're blocking my stall; step aside.
Small, but my claws are sharp.

lines.zh: 你是来买东西，还是来拆台？
lines.en: Here to buy, or to spoil trade?
Bend down. My neck tires.
Mind the lava around here.
I know gold script, not you.
Keep your hand back. I bite.
Ow, my tail.
My horn is knocked askew. Straightening it.
On your account.
I hop two paces and shake myself.
It hurts, and I still stand.
The book nearly fell in the lava.
Striking a small one. No shame?
One claw tip broke.
I hiss and duck behind a crate.
Prices just went up.
Nether coin? Now we can talk.
I take the gold, you pick a book.
Netherite? You would part with it?
This coin is poor quality.
I do not eat bread. I eat firelight.

lines.zh: 你把币放在石头上，别递手。
lines.en: Set the coin on the stone. No hands.
Two coins buys a thin one.
This chain? Not for sale.
You are jingling that gold too loudly.
Deal. No haggling.
Nether coins for me, the book for you.
I am small. One bump and I flip.
Do not knee me.
Back up so I can stand.
My horn hits your shin.
One bump. I will note it.
I bounce off and roll twice.
The floor is hot. I cannot stop.
Do not crowd; this is a narrow ledge.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比我整个人大。
lines.en: Your boot is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 爪牙在下界是这副模样。
lines.en: Minions look like this down here.
That question needs a chain.

lines.zh: 我们三个世界，三种形态。
lines.en: Three worlds, three forms for us.
Gargoyles fly. I do not.

lines.zh: 我的同类大多在找买家。
lines.en: Most of my kin are finding buyers.
That will not buy a book.

lines.zh: 尾巴圈起来，就是我的家。
lines.en: A curled tail is home enough.
Ask about trade and I answer.

lines.zh: 火里生出来的，不谈这个。
lines.en: Born of fire. We skip that topic.

lines.zh: 下界合金能锁我，别的不能。
lines.en: Only netherite holds my form.
I pick up this nether coin.
A loose page goes back in the book.
This gold is mine now.

lines.zh: 地上烫，我用爪尖挑起来。
lines.en: The floor burns. I flick it up.
Your dropped key. Here.
It fell in the lava. A pity.
I tuck it at my waist.
This cloth will wrap my book.

lines.zh: 捡东西要先看有没有主。
lines.en: Check for an owner before picking up.
Two coins. I will hold them for you.
Taking a book without paying?

lines.zh: 爪子从下界火里伸出来了。
lines.en: My claws come out of Nether fire.
I have my eye on your pocket.
This deal has gone bad.

lines.zh: 小个子也有小个子的打法。
lines.en: Small ones fight small.
I count three and you pay.
The chain rattles. I move.
Not a big target. Easy to bite.

lines.zh: 你踩了我的尾巴，记得吗？
lines.en: You stepped on my tail. Remember?
I close the book.
Firelight shows me. No running.
I have hopped to your feet.
Now you owe me two coins.
Claws settle faster than haggling.
No shouting. Straight in.
I circle you, looking for an ankle.
Low to the ground. You cannot hit me.
I hop on a crate for height.
You back off; I follow three hops.
My tail sweeps dust off the floor.
Hand over the nether coin and the book's yours.
Your shield is high. Your feet are bare.
Lava is close to you. I know.
I have circled behind you.
My claws have tested the angle.
Hear the chain rattle?
I wait for you to look down.
I know this terrain well.
The more you rush, the easier you are.
One hop and the gap is gone.
My horn points at your knee.
The flame flickers and I move.
Two blocks left. You cannot stop.
My claws rake your trouser leg.
I leap and ram your knee.
Small teeth, deep bite.
My tail sweeps; you stumble.
Not for coin. For spite.
I bite your bootlace.
My horn meets bone. Loud.
Bend to grab me. Perfect.
I strike and duck behind a crate.
Three claw marks left.
This bite settles your debt.
Bite, then hop back.

lines.zh: 你脚下一滑，我再来一下。
lines.en: You slip; I strike again.
A small flame follows my claws.
I hold on. You cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 疼吧？下界就是这么过日子的。
lines.en: Hurts? That is life in the Nether.
By the lava, I pop out.

lines.zh: 一本魔法书落在地上，我来了。
lines.en: A spellbook lands, and here I am.

lines.zh: 我从下界砖缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a nether brick seam.

lines.zh: 萤石的亮里，多了个影子。
lines.en: A shadow joins the glowstone light.
The chain rattles and I take shape.
Tail first, then the rest of me.
The hot wind wakes me.
Someone lit a fire in the tunnel.
I shake my horns and settle.
The shop opens. A customer.

lines.zh: 我从火里走出来，脚还冒烟。
lines.en: I step out of the fire, feet smoking.
This stretch of tunnel is mine.

lines.zh: 小个子也有登场的时候。
lines.en: Even small ones get an entrance.
I open the book and wait.
Fire does not scare me, but my fur is singed.

lines.zh: 从砖台摔下来，翻了两个跟头。
lines.en: Off the ledge, two flips, and down.
Water? In the Nether? Miserable.
The blast slams me into a corner.
An arrow pins me to the wall.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的形状压小了。
lines.en: Magic presses my shape smaller.
No firelight, and I fade.

lines.zh: 雷劈进下界砖，我跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits nether brick; I jump.

lines.zh: 脚下石头一空，我往下坠。
lines.en: The stone gives and I fall away.
